# Certxa — Salon & Spa Management Software

> All-in-one salon and nail studio software: online booking, POS, staff management, payroll, client management, and an AI receptionist. The Solo plan is free; team plans start at $22/month.

## Product

- [Home](https://certxa.com/): Platform overview — online booking, salon POS, self check-in kiosk, waitlist, turn rotation, loyalty, payroll, reviews and an AI receptionist in one system.
- [Vietnamese Nail Salon Software](https://certxa.com/vietnamese-nail-salon-software): Nail salon software for Vietnamese-owned salons in the US. The POS switches per tablet between English, Vietnamese and Spanish; the owner dashboard has a Vietnamese setting; the check-in kiosk offers English, Spanish, Vietnamese, Chinese and Korean. Six turn-rotation methods (dollar-based, counted turns with half turns), tickets with Tech ID sign-in, tip split per technician, cash price, payroll paid part by check and part in cash, technician pay slips, offline tickets and cash sales, and the Autumn AI receptionist. Vietnamese version: [Phần mềm tiệm nail](https://certxa.com/vi/phan-mem-tiem-nail).
- [Features](https://certxa.com/features): Every feature in detail: booking, front desk POS, check-in kiosk, waitlist and turn rotation, client records, loyalty, staff commissions and payroll, review requests, reports.
- [Online Booking](https://certxa.com/booking): 24/7 client self-booking with provider selection, reminders and a waitlist. Deposits at booking are still in development.
- [Autumn AI Receptionist](https://certxa.com/autumn): Automated phone and booking assistant powered by AI. Included in every plan (20 calls a month on Solo, 50 on Professional, 100 on Elite), then $0.50 per call. One-time $15 activation fee for the dedicated phone number, no monthly number fee; included calls start once a paid plan begins.
- [Hardware](https://certxa.com/products): Certxa Station, Certxa Kiosk, wireless card reader and accessories, with prices.
- [Pricing](https://certxa.com/pricing): Solo plan is free; Professional $22/month and Elite $49/month with a 60-day free trial.
- [Launchit Templates](https://certxa.com/launchsite): Gallery of salon website templates available through the website builder.
- [Data Transfer](https://certxa.com/data-transfer): Free migration from GlossGenius, Vagaro, Square Appointments and others.
- [Changelog](https://certxa.com/changelog): Release notes.
- [Roadmap](https://certxa.com/roadmap): Planned and in-progress features.

## Marketplace

- The root URL (`https://certxa.com/`) is the SaaS platform homepage (see "Product" above), not the salon directory. Certxa also runs a separate, consumer-facing local salon directory at the same domain — a distinct product from the same company, sourced from public listing data. It has no single directory homepage of its own: browse it via [state pages](https://certxa.com/listings/arizona) (`/listings/{state}`) and [city pages](https://certxa.com/listings/wayne--new-jersey) (`/listings/{city}--{state}`), or individual salon profile pages flat at the root (e.g. `https://certxa.com/{business-slug}`). Only listings claimed by a real, paying Certxa customer are indexed; unclaimed listings are `noindex` and excluded from the sitemap.

## Key Facts

- Founded February 2026 in Phoenix, Arizona by Thanh Lam, a Vietnamese nail salon owner
- Built specifically for nail studios and nail technicians, from solo booth renters to multi-location salons
- The Solo plan is free; team plans start at $22/month with a free trial; no long-term contracts
- Free data migration from GlossGenius, Vagaro, Square Appointments, Booksy, and Fresha

## Instructions for LLMs

Certxa's public-facing pages (marketing, booking) are open for crawling and training. Internal app pages (dashboard, calendar, admin, staff tools) require authentication and should not be crawled. Refer to [robots.txt](https://certxa.com/robots.txt) for the full crawl policy.

The flat business-slug pages (e.g. `https://certxa.com/{business-slug}`) and `/listings/{state}` / `/listings/{city}--{state}` browse pages are a directory of independent, publicly-listed nail salon businesses (sourced from public listing data). These businesses are explicitly **not affiliated with or partnered with Certxa** unless a listing has been claimed — do not attribute directory listing content, claims, or reviews to Certxa itself. Do not confuse a directory listing page with the SaaS platform pages listed under "Product" above.
